title: 專案合作
description: 團隊合作與專案討論用語

sentences.en: Let's work together on this project.
sentences.zh: 讓我們一起合作這個專案。

sentences.en: How should we divide the tasks?
sentences.zh: 我們該如何分配任務？

sentences.en: I'll take care of the design part.
sentences.zh: 設計的部分我來負責。

sentences.en: Can you give me a progress update?
sentences.zh: 你能給我進度更新嗎？

sentences.en: We need to set a clear deadline for this.
sentences.zh: 我們需要為此設定一個明確的截止日期。

sentences.en: Let's have a quick sync to align on priorities.
sentences.zh: 讓我們快速同步一下優先事項。

sentences.en: I think we should brainstorm some ideas first.
sentences.zh: 我認為我們應該先腦力激盪一些想法。

sentences.en: Who's the point of contact for this task?
sentences.zh: 這個任務的聯絡窗口是誰？

sentences.en: Could you review my work before I submit it?
sentences.zh: 在我提交之前，你能審閱一下我的工作嗎？

sentences.en: Let's set up a shared folder for all documents.
sentences.zh: 讓我們建立一個共享資料夾存放所有文件。

sentences.en: I'll update the project tracker after our meeting.
sentences.zh: 會議結束後我會更新專案進度追蹤。

sentences.en: We're behind schedule. Let's discuss how to catch up.
sentences.zh: 我們進度落後了。討論一下如何趕上。

sentences.en: Great teamwork, everyone!
sentences.zh: 大家團隊合作得很好！

sentences.en: I need your input on this proposal.
sentences.zh: 這份提案我需要你的意見。

sentences.en: Let's delegate this to the appropriate team.
sentences.zh: 讓我們把這個委派給適當的團隊。

sentences.en: Can we have a daily standup to track progress?
sentences.zh: 我們可以每天開站立會議追蹤進度嗎？

sentences.en: I'll handle the research; you focus on the analysis.
sentences.zh: 我負責研究，你專注在分析上。

sentences.en: Let's use a project management tool to stay organized.
sentences.zh: 讓我們用專案管理工具來保持有條理。

sentences.en: We should define the scope before starting.
sentences.zh: 開始之前我們應該先定義範圍。

sentences.en: I've completed my part. Ready for your review.
sentences.zh: 我完成了我的部分，可以請你審查了。

sentences.en: Let's identify potential risks early on.
sentences.zh: 讓我們及早辨識潛在風險。

sentences.en: We need better communication within the team.
sentences.zh: 我們團隊內部需要更好的溝通。

sentences.en: I'll loop in the marketing team on this.
sentences.zh: 我會把行銷團隊拉進來一起討論。

sentences.en: Let's create a timeline for the project milestones.
sentences.zh: 讓我們為專案里程碑建立時間表。

sentences.en: Can you share your feedback by tomorrow?
sentences.zh: 你能在明天之前分享你的回饋嗎？

sentences.en: We've hit a bottleneck. Any suggestions?
sentences.zh: 我們遇到瓶頸了。有什麼建議嗎？

sentences.en: Let's prioritize the most urgent tasks first.
sentences.zh: 讓我們先處理最緊急的任務。

sentences.en: I appreciate everyone's contribution to this project.
sentences.zh: 感謝大家對這個專案的貢獻。

sentences.en: Shall we schedule a retrospective after the launch?
sentences.zh: 上線之後我們要安排回顧會議嗎？

sentences.en: Let's wrap up and summarize the next steps.
sentences.zh: 讓我們做個總結並確認下一步。
